title: dukkhanirodhaṃ ariyasaccaṃ
titleEn: The Noble Truth of the Cessation of dukkha
credit: Pāḷi text and English translation as in Mor’s Pāḷi Workshop booklet.

paras.en:
“Now this, bhikkhus, is the noble truth of the cessation of dukkha: it is the remainderless fading away and cessation of that same craving, the giving up and relinquishing of it, freedom from it, letting go of it.
This is called the noble truth of the cessation of dukkha.”
